title: Swiss cyber office BACS reports first AI-agent-assisted attacks on companies in Switzerland
date_note: Inside-IT's article of 25 November is the earliest page; it gives no earlier day for the BACS report.
summary: Switzerland's Federal Office for Cybersecurity (BACS) reports its first attacks assisted by AI agents, Inside-IT says. Datensicherheit.de, citing Swiss media, says BACS learned of five incidents, four with a successful intrusion, affecting three critical-infrastructure companies and two SMEs. No major outages have been reported so far, according to that article. BACS urges installing critical updates quickly.
plain: Swiss authorities say criminals have used AI agents to break into companies, including operators of critical infrastructure. BACS urges quick installation of critical updates.
exec: BACS reports successful intrusions at critical-infrastructure companies and SMEs using AI agents; Datensicherheit.de says no major outages have been reported so far.
action: BACS advises installing critical security updates for internet-facing systems within 24 hours at the latest.
geo_basis: Victims are not named; the pin is the country the authority reports on.

sources.name: Inside-IT: Cyberangriffe mit KI: 100% Erfolgsquote in der Schweiz

validation.note: Inside-IT (Switzerland) and Datensicherheit.de (Germany) each report the BACS statement; the BACS page itself was not read, and Netzwoche could not be loaded.
